name: AISHELL-1 Mandarin Speech Recognition Benchmark
description: A widely used Mandarin speech recognition benchmark consisting of approximately 178 hours of read speech and standardized train/dev/test splits.
typical_sota_score: low single-digit CER on clean test conditions for modern end-to-end ASR systems
notes: A standard Mandarin ASR benchmark with clean, read-speech recordings. It is often used to compare acoustic modeling, language modeling, and end-to-end sequence transduction approaches.
